title: Fix Puzzle3d setHover Emitting Operations
prompt: Fix bug: View-kind action setHover fails on puzzle.3d.play.viewport with error View-kind action setHover must not emit operations.
summary: Fixed View-kind setHover failing with "must not emit operations" on puzzle.3d.play.viewport. Root cause: after document ops apply, the store holds puzzle_3d-shaped JSON that is not byte-identical to the plugin fixture serializer, so pure runtime actions spuriously emitted SetDocument. Normalized before through the same typed round-trip before delta (puzzle3d + puzzle5d) and added a registry regression test.
